cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? What happens if we lose?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We'll face that together. That's what the badge means.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's start with the very easy agreement to wear blue.

mechanism: A recruits a quiz teammate before disclosing the losing stakes by negotiating a smaller visible blue-team commitment.
confusable: Unlike explaining a bet and then seeking consent, A keeps the consequence undisclosed while lowering the first affiliation step.
comparison: Badge versus blue ribbon choice differs from a joint-entrant signature and penalty text.
seedUse: D199-a quiz badge, losing question and blue; S02-a adapts the recruitment action to B reluctance.
